protocol.title: Single-asset options implied-vol term ratio (near/far near-ATM IV) -> forward downside-semivariance share of the signed return predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (identical term_ratio signal via _term_bars) + EVAL-102 (single-asset term_ratio signal path verbatim) + EVAL-115/EVAL-165 (forward downside-semivariance-share target verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed / zwindow); distinct cell: single-asset term_ratio -> forward downside-semivariance share
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- fills the term_ratio cell of the downside-semivariance-share grid (atm_iv EVAL-115, skew EVAL-165); complements EVAL-102 (term_ratio -> signed return mean) and EVAL-162 (term_ratio -> CVaR) with a distributional-dispersion target; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term structure from the real Deribit option trade tape: term_ratio = IV(near expiry)/IV(far expiry) - 1, forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward downside-semivariance share = downside_semivariance / total_variance over the SAME underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k); downside semivariance = mean(min(r - mu, 0)^2), total variance = mean((r - mu)^2)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(term_ratio_z_k, downside_share_forward_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher near/far IV ratio -> higher forward downside-semivariance share)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
